## Workload

During the review period, grader Elif Sahin completed 564 reads over 268 hours. This represents 2.1 reads per hour. The workload information provides a basis for assessing activity during the period and supports comparison with the quality findings below.

## Quality

A sample of 46 reads was checked by reviewer Priya Anand. The recorded agreement rate was 54.3 per cent. The check covered the work completed during the review period and provides an indication of consistency between the grader’s decisions and the reviewer’s assessment. These findings should be considered alongside the workload information when reviewing overall performance.
